definitions.explanation: The blanket-like covering used on top of the body when sleeping, as opposed to the mattress ({敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん}) underneath.

examples.japanese: {冬|ふゆ}は{厚|あつ}い{掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}を{使|つか}う。
examples.english: I use a thick comforter in winter.

examples.japanese: {掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}を{干|ほ}してふかふかにした。
examples.english: I aired out the comforter to make it fluffy.

examples.japanese: {羽毛|うもう}{掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}は{軽|かる}くて{暖|あたた}かい。
examples.english: A down comforter is light and warm.

notes:
FORMATION:
{掛|か}け (from {掛|か}ける, to put over) + {布団|ぶとん} (futon/bedding)

Literally 'covering futon.'

COLLOCATIONS:
・{掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}を{掛|か}ける - to put on a comforter
・{掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん}を{干|ほ}す - to air out a comforter
・{羽毛|うもう}{掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん} - down comforter
・{夏|なつ}{掛|か}け{布団|ぶとん} - summer comforter (thin)

RELATED WORDS:
・{敷|し}き{布団|ぶとん} - mattress futon (underneath)
・{毛布|もうふ} - blanket
・{布団|ぶとん}カバー - futon cover
